title: AI risk scores on prior mammograms detect a share of interval cancers
summary: A deep-learning system scored the preceding screening mammograms of 429 women with interval cancer in Southern Sweden. The AI risk score correlated with radiologist consensus classification (true negative, minimal signs, false negative), and the AI detected 19% of interval cancers that showed at least minimal signs and were correctly localized. The authors conclude AI could potentially reduce interval cancer rate.
ai_technology: Commercial deep-learning system giving 1-10 risk scores and lesion localization on mammograms

evidence.tested: Retrospective cohort with radiologist consensus review.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; no matched screen-detected controls in the abstract; reduction not prospectively tested; full text not reviewed.
